business_problem: Zhihu needed faster internal application delivery for cost-optimization projects and a more accessible way for business users to analyze and act on platform data.
solution_summary: Zhihu adopted two Baidu AI Cloud platforms that work at different layers of internal productivity. AisuDa, the low-code platform, is used to accelerate front-end and business-application delivery by giving engineers and even non-front-end staff a drag-and-drop environment for CRUD pages and other application screens. Its architecture emphasizes openness—no vendor lock-in, open front-end renderer, conventional databases and loose coupling between front end, editor and back end—so it can fit into Zhihu's engineering practices rather than forcing a closed ecosystem. On the analytics side, Sugar BI gives business teams a modeling and visualization environment that can connect raw data tables, apply associations and preprocessing without changing the originals, and then expose charts and dashboards with permission control. Together, the two products create a development-to-analysis productivity stack: AisuDa speeds application creation and lowers communication overhead, while Sugar makes large-scale data interpretation easier for managers and operational teams.

solution_components.role: Accelerates internal application development through an open low-code environment.

solution_components.name: Sugar BI

solution_components.name: Data Modeling Module

solution_components.name: Permission Control
solution_components.role: Separates departments and controls data access inside the BI environment.

data_flow: Business requirements become internal apps on AisuDa, while operational and product data is modeled in Sugar BI, turned into dashboards and then fed back to managers and teams for decision-making and optimization.
business_outcome: Zhihu reduced development effort for internal systems, shortened delivery cycles and made platform data easier for both leaders and frontline teams to understand and use.
metrics: Low-code development efficiency is 3x to 8x that of traditional methods.
Dozens of Zhihu applications already run on AisuDa.
AisuDa usage reached roughly 700 users and about 8,000 daily page views in one internal week snapshot.
architecture_clues: AisuDa is deliberately open, with no middle layer and no required cloud lock-in
Sugar separates modeling from raw data changes
The BI layer includes department-level isolation and fine-grained permissions
